environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-constraints' at priority 200 containing a RegexMatchStatement on query string values with pattern '[^a-zA-Z0-9_.\-\s]' that returns BLOCK for any match on URI path '/api/v1/products/search', and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The ALB target group health check hits /health. CloudWatch Logs capture WAF sampled requests. The custom rule at priority 200 applies a strict character allowlist to ALL query string parameter values on the search endpoint.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL 'inventory-waf-acl'
config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-constraints' priority=200 action=BLOCK, RegexMatchStatement on SingleQueryArgument for all query params matching '[^a-zA-Z0-9_.\-\s]' scoped to URI path '/api/v1/products/search'
